description: This file defines the Administrator class and related components for managing RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and message dispatching within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures for handling inter-process communication and object lifetime management.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and message dispatching, including registration, lookup, and lifetime management of remote objects.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for handling IPC messages within the framework.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server implementations that can submit and revoke jobs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Administrator.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers an interface with its stub and proxy types.

methods.name: Recall
methods.description: Unregisters an interface, cleaning up associated resources.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a proxy for a given interface and implementation ID is valid.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for a proxy object or releases a proxy.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface instance with the IPC channel.

methods.name: UnregisterInterface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface instance from the IPC channel.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a communication channel and handles associated proxies.
